nina_pm: Heads-up 5m 5m5m we're consolidating onboarding gates for model catalog entries. Want a short thread to align launch thresholds and customer escape routes. Keep replies short.

diego_ml: Proposing acceptance thresholds: QA accuracy delta <= 2% absolute on sampled prompts, embedding cosine drop <= 0.03, latency p95 delta <= 50ms. Also require no function-call schema breakages.

tara_support: Customers asked for explicit 'don't migrate' control. We should support a pin with TTL and one emergency hold. Also provide migration opt-out via support ticket for enterprise.

ethan_sre: Operational rules: canary steps: 0.5% traffic for 24h -> 5% for 48h -> 25% for 72h. Auto-rollback triggers: error rate +0.4% absolute, p95 increase >200ms, or 99th perc token cost spike >20%.

diego_ml: Bench infra will require two consecutive days of passing regression suite and a manual review for hallucination-sensitive prompt categories.

bench_bot: Bench summary for candidate 'helix-2026-03' vs baseline 'helix-2025-12': accuracy -1.2%, embed drift 0.022, p95 +33ms. Full: https://internal.redwood/bench/1769993331

nina_pm: Decision notes: pin TTL default 60d, one-time 30d extension via console for enterprise, support ticket emergency hold. Tenant-wide pins initially; per-route pins marked as 'post-1.0'.

tara_support: Will draft help center content for pinning and emergency hold flow.

diego_ml: Add an automated compatibility test for function-call signatures. If mismatch >5% we block onboarding.

ethan_sre: I'll prepare a rollback playbook and an infra checklist for canary infra. Need product to own the migration comms.

nina_pm: I'll own comms. Next steps: Diego run two more bench runs; Tara draft support pages; Ethan create rollback docs. Check back Friday. :rocket:
